units: Reported Amount in metric tons, confirmed by Basel national-reporting manual Table 4. Numeric values retained in metric tonnes; original strings retained.

method: Official Table 4 export records have been acquired for offline evaluation. Public quantitative reuse is withheld pending permission. The reporting manual instructs Parties to summarize exported/imported amounts by waste and D/R code; for general notifications it uses quantities received on movement documents, assigned by arrival date at the receiving facility. D/R codes indicate the operation the waste was destined for, not audited completion. Controlled waste includes hazardous and other waste.
geographicCoverage: Reporting Parties with valid destination and mass values; country/report coverage differs by year. Missing reports do not imply no waste movements.
temporalCoverage: 2023–2024 national reports, retrieved 2026-09-19; operation taxonomy is Annex IV before the amendment effective 2030-01-01.
publicationBlocker: Explicit reuse terms do not grant public derivative or commercial redistribution rights; preserve originals and adapter offline, show unavailable state with official source link.
